evidence_limits: Short reconstructed English AI-domain entity extraction only; not multilingual, long-document, classification, attribute, relation, record, or JointIE quality.
All fourteen author labels are queried using original spellings with no descriptions/examples; threshold 0.5, flat overlap, and strict decoding were frozen before test.
Entire official test split retained, including repeated test rows; development overlap exclusions are text-only and recorded in the preparation audit.
No model or threshold tuning uses this test; no absolute held-out quality floor or performance claim is asserted. The agreed relative degradation gates are evaluated separately.
Original article identity, near-duplicate article membership, and pretraining/teacher contamination remain unknown.
Exact typed byte-span metric is a named local contract and has not yet been differential-tested against an official BIO scorer.
Metal held-out runs are not included in this evidence version.
review_method: Reproduce blinded requests and separate gold from all locked official test rows with prepare_fixture.
Use load_reference to verify report identity and response/prediction/metric file hashes and reconstruct predictions from actual outputs and metrics from separate gold.
Compare every exact encoder token sequence and ordered canonical output, using unchanged confidence_absolute_tolerance 0.0005.
Recompute every stored source_fp32 comparison and every reduced quality delta; original FP32 metric families must be identical across Python and native.
